BiblicalUsage: tsîy stands behind the English phrase a ship. In Numbers 24:24, ships shall come from the coast of Chittim, and it appears again in Isaiah 33:21.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the ships of Balaam's oracle and of Isaiah both come from beyond, and God rules the seas they sail.
